study: DINOv2-small local normal memory and sparse positive prototypes
status: exploratory v3 zero-change convention and cold-load feasibility amendment before source inference; v1/v2 synthetic-only receipts retained
source_scope: original train24 only; reused selection8 only after frozen train gate; never original exposed test8
representation: frozen official facebook/dinov2-small; two full-width RGB crops in top,bottom order: y[0:ceil(.6H)] then y[floor(.4H):H], each resized224x224 PIL bilinear; official ImageNet normalization;2CLS384 and16x16patchtokens meanpooled4x4cells per tile->32cells384, L2unit each
sampling: sequential source PTS every2sec from0; bounded146sec duration; at most74 samples; no annotation-driven extraction
centered_patch: subtract per-clip temporal median of cell embeddings, then unit L2; no learned transform and no cross-video fit
zero_change_convention: any query cell with L2norm<1e-8 has minimum review signal:normal_novelty0 andpositive_normal_margin-2; stable zero motion is not treated as maximum novelty
memory: each normal fitting clip at most16 uniform chronological samples; positive fitting samples within2.001sec of sparse anchors only, at most8 uniform eligible samples; all other positive times unknown
spatial_score: cosine nearest neighbor at same cell/tile; normal_novelty=1-maxcos(normal), positive_normal_margin=maxcos(positive)-maxcos(normal); average largest4 of32 cells or both2CLS scores
selection: four fixed stratified content-group training folds; no fold sees its held-out clip in memory; maximize standardized partialAUC atFPR.25 then ROC-AUC then declared order; threshold trainOOF only
threshold: require specificity>=.8, recall>=.5, balanced_accuracy>=.65; maximize balancedaccuracy then precision then specificity then higher threshold; reject allpositive/allnegative
development_gate: single frozen choice on reused8 selection groups, specificity>=.75, recall>=.75, BA>=.75; exploratory support only, not independent competition accuracy
runtime: CPU two threads; local_files_only; no remote_code; one heavy process; 295sec per clip watchdog; no silent exclusion/retry
privacy: source data, labels, arrays, split identifiers and per-clip outputs remain private; only aggregate metrics published
